Our client is a growing technology company based in the heart of Brussels, developing business-critical solutions within a highly regulated and fast-evolving environment.Technology is at the core of its strategy, with several exciting projects planned over the coming years, including a significant migration towards AWS.

The successful candidate will work on backend development with PHP and Laravel, contribute to a major AWS migration project, and progressively become a technical reference within the team
 

• Develop and maintain scalable backend applications using PHP and Laravel.
• Participate in the modernization of the technology stack and cloud migration initiatives.
• Collaborate closely with technical leadership on architectural decisions.
• Ensure code quality through reviews, testing, and best development practices.
• Analyse business needs and translate them into robust technical solutions.
• Troubleshoot complex technical issues and propose long-term improvements.
• Contribute to system reliability, security, and performance optimization.
• Share knowledge and support the growth of the development team.

• Minimum 7 years of software development experience.
• Strong expertise in PHP and Laravel.
• Experience working on complex business applications.
• Ability to work independently and quickly identify priorities.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Professional English communication skills.
• You can quickly understand an existing ecosystem and become a key contributor.

• You enjoy working with experienced engineers in a collaborative and low-ego environment.

Our client is a key player in the healthcare and social services sector. The work environment is dynamic, collaborative, and innovation-driven, with a strong focus on modernizing its IT landscape and continuously improving operational performance. 
They are looking for a Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer to join a team responsible for the implementation, maintenance, support, and administration of the network infrastructure.
This includes network hardware, PCs and servers, printers and other peripherals, as well as the core software installed on them, both at the head office and across around one hundred remote sites.

Jobomschrijving

• Implement, maintain, and administer the organization's network infrastructure, including network hardware, servers, PCs, printers, peripherals, and foundational software.
• Support the helpdesk on complex technical issues and provide advanced assistance to end users.
• Monitor system performance, conduct tuning activities, and ensure the stability and reliability of all network and server environments.
• Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to guarantee operational continuity.
• Collaborate with software development teams and intervene on existing applications when needed.
• Mentor and support junior team members, sharing best practices and helping them develop technical skills.
• Analyze technical needs and contribute to the design, documentation, and implementation of new technical solutions.
• Ensure the security, resilience, and scalability of the IT infrastructure across all sites.
• Stay up to date with relevant technologies and propose improvements to enhance the IT landscape.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.
• Minimum 10 years of proven experience in a similar role with demonstrated progression.
• Valid driving license (Category B).
• You have a good command of technical English and a passive knowledge of Dutch (you can understand Dutch-speaking participants during meetings and work based on documentation written in Dutch).

Technical Skills

• Strong expertise in managing a Windows 11 desktop fleet and related peripherals.
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server 2019/2022.
• Good overall knowledge of Linux.
• Strong understanding of LAN/WAN configuration.
• Knowledge of relational databases.

Assets (Nice to Have)

• Experience with Aruba switches.
• Knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise 9, JBoss, Docker.
• Knowledge of PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server.
• Experience with VMware ESX virtualization.
• Basic software development knowledge.
• Experience creating MSI packages and scripting in PHP.
• Knowledge of Office 365 administration.

Our client is an international organization with a strong reputation in its sector and operations across multiple European markets. Known for its commitment to quality, responsible business practices, and continuous improvement, the company offers a collaborative and multicultural environment where people play a central role in driving success.

Jobomschrijving

As a Senior HR Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting both employees and managers across several countries and functions.

Acting as a trusted HR partner, you will accompany teams throughout the employee lifecycle, provide day-to-day guidance on people-related topics, and help managers create engaging and high-performing work environments.

This role combines operational involvement with strategic HR initiatives. You will spend time close to the business, understanding the realities of different teams, supporting managers in their people challenges, and ensuring a consistent employee experience across the organization.

HR Partnership & Employee Support

• Act as the primary HR contact for employees and managers within your assigned business areas.
• Build strong relationships with teams and maintain a close understanding of business and people challenges.
• Support managers in addressing day-to-day HR topics, employee engagement, team dynamics, and people development.
• Accompany employees throughout their journey within the company, ensuring a positive and consistent experience.
• Regularly connect with teams across different locations to stay close to operational realities.

Employee Relations & People Management

• Advise and support managers on employee relations matters, performance concerns, wellbeing topics, and workplace issues.
• Ensure people decisions are aligned with company policies and local employment regulations.
• Facilitate constructive dialogue between managers and employees when needed.
• Support disciplinary processes and sensitive employee cases with professionalism and discretion.

Talent & Performance

• Coordinate performance management and talent review processes within your scope.
• Support managers in identifying development opportunities and building individual growth plans.
• Contribute to initiatives aimed at strengthening leadership and team capabilities.
• Participate in succession planning and talent development discussions.

Employee Experience & Engagement

• Support onboarding and integration activities to ensure a strong employee experience from day one.
• Contribute to engagement initiatives and help foster a collaborative and inclusive culture.
• Gather feedback from employees and managers and translate insights into practical improvements.
• Promote a culture of continuous feedback and development.

HR Projects & Continuous Improvement

• Contribute to HR projects, process improvements, and the implementation of new initiatives.
• Help improve HR tools, policies, and ways of working.
• Support HR reporting and analysis when required.
• Collaborate closely with other HR functions to ensure a seamless employee experience.

Experience & Background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
• More than 7 years of experience as HR Business Partner within an international and fast-paced environment.
• Proven experience supporting both managers and employees across a broad range of HR topics.
• Strong exposure to employee relations, performance management, talent development, and organizational change.
• Good understanding of European employment legislation; experience across multiple countries is an asset.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to establish credibility at all levels of the organization.
• Hands-on and pragmatic approach, with a genuine interest in supporting people and solving problems.
• Excellent communication and coaching skills.
• Ability to manage sensitive situations with discretion and professionalism.
• Well-organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
• Data-aware, with good knowledge of HR systems and reporting tools.
• Fluent in French and English; additional European languages are considered a plus.
• Collaborative, approachable, and committed to delivering an excellent employee experience.

jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international retailer known for its collaborative culture, innovation, and continuous improvement mindset.

• Manage and reconcile financial transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards.
• Participate in monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities and support financial reporting under BE GAAP and IFRS.

Our client is a major real estate and infrastructure organization managing large-scale public-private partnership projects focused on the development, operation, and long-term maintenance of public facilities.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage a portfolio of approximately 25 building projects, coordinating maintenance activities and ensuring smooth collaboration between clients, contractors, and other stakeholders.
• Act as the main point of contact for administrative, technical, contractual, insurance, and damage-related matters, while mediating conflicts and facilitating mutually acceptable solutions.
• Coordinate maintenance requests, technical inspections, change requests, and interventions through a dedicated helpdesk and ensure proper follow-up with the relevant parties.
• Monitor the technical condition, regulatory compliance, and overall performance of the buildings, including annual condition assessments based on NEN 2767 standards and follow-up of corrective actions.

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Engineering, Facility Management, Real Estate, or equivalent professional experience, with 3-5 years of relevant experience in maintenance, technical consultancy, or real estate.
• Strong knowledge of building technical systems and maintenance requirements, ideally gained through experience with schools, offices, hospitals, or other large public/commercial buildings.
• Excellent communication, consultation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to mediate conflicts and build strong professional relationships.
• Proactive, customer-oriented, highly organized, and solution-driven, with strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently as well as within multidisciplinary teams.
• Fluent in Dutch, with a good command of French and English, and proficient in MS Office and technical/construction documentation tools such as CAD and relevant maintenance or project-management applications.

As a Private Banker Assistant, you will support Private Bankers in managing client relationships and ensuring smooth daily operations.

Brussels Capital Wealth is a boutique wealth management firm based in Brussels, supporting affluent individuals and entrepreneurs with personalized banking and investment solutions. We combine financial expertise with a high level of client service in an international and dynamic environment.

Omschrijving

• Support Private Bankers in managing client portfolios.
• Prepare client meetings and reports.
• Handle account opening and KYC documentation.
• Follow up on client requests and transactions.
• Coordinate with Compliance and Operations teams.

• Strong organizational and communication skills.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
	
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.	
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.	
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.	
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.	
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.	
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities.

	
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.	
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.	
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.	
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.	
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.	
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

VG 458/BUOSAP

Are you an organised and service-oriented professional who enjoys being at the heart of office life? In this part-time role, you will support the daily operations of a busy international office, ensuring employees and visitors enjoy a seamless and welcoming workplace experience.

Our client is an internationally active organisation with offices across multiple countries. Their Brussels team operates in a professional, collaborative and multicultural environment where efficiency, excellent service and teamwork are key to success.

As the organisation continues to grow, they are looking for a reliable Office Operations Assistant to help maintain smooth day-to-day office activities and provide essential administrative support.

 

Description

• Act as the first point of contact for visitors, answering calls and welcoming guests professionally.
• Provide administrative support including data entry, document preparation, proofreading and reporting.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, catering arrangements and logistics for internal meetings and events.
• Manage office supplies, kitchen stock, consumables and general workplace organisation.
• Handle incoming and outgoing mail, deliveries and courier services.
• Support facilities-related requests and liaise with external suppliers when needed.
• Assist with access badge administration, workspace set-up and daily office inspections.

Are you a hands-on and service-minded professional who enjoys creating a welcoming and well-organised workplace? In this varied role, you will ensure the smooth daily operation of a modern international office while acting as a key contact for employees, visitors and external service providers.

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.

With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

 

Description

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.

A professional services organisation based in Brussels.

• Maintain and update recruitment databases and records.
